heroTitle: A space to come back to yourself
heroText: Mindful movement, breath and calm in welcoming classes, adapted to your pace and open to every level.
aboutTitle: No rush, no pressure, with room to feel
aboutText: At Alma Tierra, yoga is a personal practice rather than a goal. We create a welcoming atmosphere where everyone can explore movement, rest and reconnect with themselves.
classesIntro: Choose a dynamic, gentle or restorative practice. We will help you find the class that feels right for you.
class1Text: Fluid sequences to energise the body, improve mobility and connect movement with breath.
class2Text: Supported, longer-held postures and stillness to release tension and give the nervous system a deep rest.
class3Text: An accessible class to move the joints, ease stiffness and feel more comfortable in everyday life.
scheduleTitle: Make room in your diary for yourself
scheduleText: Places are limited. Message us to check availability and reserve your mat.
communityText: We care for the atmosphere, the groups and every detail so you feel welcome from day one. You do not need to prove anything here: simply arrive as you are.
quote: “Practice begins when we stop comparing ourselves.”
a1: No. We have classes for beginners and offer variations to adapt every posture.
q2: Do I need to bring a mat?
a2: You can bring your own, but the studio provides mats, blocks, blankets and other props.
q3: How do I book a class?
a3: Message us with your preferred class and time. We will confirm availability.
a4: Comfortable clothing that allows you to move freely. You do not need footwear for practice.
contactText: Tell us what you are looking for and we will suggest the most suitable class.
demoNote: Fictional contact details for this demonstration website.

footerText: Movement, breath and calm at your pace.
